prompt: Create a dreamy vertical watercolor photo-collage portrait of a young East Asian woman with long wavy brown hair, windswept and tousled, bathed in golden-hour backlight. Use a warm beige handmade-paper background with soft watercolor washes, speckled ink splatters, deckled translucent edges, and faint metallic-gold geometric hexagon line accents. Compose exactly 2 photographic portrait panels blended into the paper: the large top panel is an extreme close-up of her face and shoulders, laughing candidly with crinkled eyes, glowing rim light in her hair, loose strands across her face, delicate dangling earrings, and a beige trench coat; the smaller lower panel shows her full body from behind on a wooden lakeside pier at sunset, turning back over her shoulder and smiling, the same beige trench coat belted at the waist, shimmering water and distant hills softly blurred behind her. Frame the collage with exactly 2 botanical watercolor border clusters: one blue flower cluster on the left with large translucent blossoms, small buds, stems, and blue ink droplets; one golden-brown leafy branch cluster on the right with delicate leaves and tiny warm splatters. Overall style should feel romantic, airy, nostalgic, mixed-media scrapbook, realistic photography fused with watercolor illustration, soft focus, warm sunlight, subtle paper grain, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张梦幻的竖版水彩照片拼贴人像，主角为 一位年轻的东亚女性，拥有 飘逸凌乱的长波浪棕色卷发，沐浴在黄金时刻的逆光中。使用温暖的米色手工纸作为背景，辅以柔和的水彩晕染、细碎的墨点、毛边半透明边缘，以及淡淡的金属金几何六边形线条装饰。画面由 2 个融入纸张的摄影人像框组成：上方较大的画框为面部和肩部的特写，展现她开怀大笑的神态，眼角带着笑纹，发丝间有明亮的轮廓光，几缕发丝垂在脸颊，佩戴精致的垂坠耳环，身穿 米色风衣；下方较小的画框展示她站在湖边木栈道上的全身背影，回眸微笑，腰间系着同款米色风衣，背景是虚化的波光粼粼的水面和远山。拼贴画四周点缀 2 组植物水彩边框：左侧为蓝色花簇，包含大型半透明花朵、小花蕾、茎秆和蓝色墨滴；右侧为金棕色枝叶簇，带有精致的叶片和细小的暖色喷溅。整体风格应呈现浪漫、轻盈、怀旧的混合媒介剪贴簿质感，将写实摄影与水彩插画融为一体，柔焦效果，温暖阳光，细腻纸张纹理，无文字，无水印。
